purpose: Audit the original fifteen importers. The user accepted thirteen retained importers, two removals and the NFO / ComicInfo naming on 2026-10-15.

method.repositoryPopularityMetric: GitHub stars are a weak public-visibility proxy, not user counts or reliability scores.
method.textHashes: SHA-256 is calculated over the UTF-8 encoding of decoded response text, not compressed wire bytes.
method.scope: Format-selection research; supported version ranges and all field mappings still require per-importer design and genuine fixtures.

items.name: Goodreads
items.baselineAndInput: 官方公开 CSV 样例与帮助站导出说明；公开样例为旧表头系列
items.migrationValue: 轻小说、漫画的书架、评分、评价与明确阅读事实；可作为没有本地电子书的用户记录入口
items.boundaries: 样例不包含当前设计列出的全部字段，不能据此宣称现行完整导出已验证；书籍版本、单册和整部作品先对应。CSV 不提供电子书，也不能重建逐次阅读区间
findingCaveats: The official sample is a legacy CSV template, not a newly generated account export.
The current full export dialect and optional fields still need genuine fixtures.
A single book or edition does not establish whole-series completion or a native root-work rating.

items.name: Vnite
items.baselineAndInput: v4.14.0；`vnite-database-*.zip` 中的 PouchDB 数据目录，备份前关闭数据库
items.migrationValue: 游戏资料、外部身份、个人评分与状态、合集、起止时间记录、图文回忆、图片和本地启动设置；游戏经历的内容较完整
items.boundaries: 不是普通条目 JSON；各数据库和附件要一起解释。`multiple` 只有状态含义，不能据此捏造完成次数；总量和区间不能重复计时
findingCaveats: The backup is a PouchDB data directory, not a plain game JSON export.
Source status multiple does not establish an exact completion count.
Intervals, daily summaries and totals must not be counted more than once.

items.name: Playnite
items.baselineAndInput: 10.62；ZIP 内 `library`、可选 `libraryfiles`，或完整一致的库副本；集合采用 LiteDB
items.migrationValue: 用户整理、标签和分类、评分、完成状态、累计游玩时长、文件与启动动作；覆盖一般游戏库迁出
items.boundaries: `Playtime` 为秒；`PlayCount` 是游玩次数。完成状态是可自定义的独立对象，不能只按一组固定名称硬编码；插件记录另有格式
findingCaveats: The core collection files use LiteDB, not SQLite.
Playtime is seconds; PlayCount does not count whole-work completions.
CompletionStatusId refers to user-editable objects; plugin data requires separate supported formats.

items.name: PotatoVN
items.baselineAndInput: v1.10.2.0；`.pvnExport.zip` 导出游戏、库、分类、staff 和图片；另有版本化单目录元数据备份
items.migrationValue: 面向 Galgame 的整理、源身份、角色与职员资料、评论、评分、游玩记录和本地配置
items.boundaries: `PlayedTime` 为按日分钟汇总，`TotalPlayTime` 由其求和；两者不能叠加，也不能生成精确活动。全库导出与单游戏 `GameMetaBackup` 版本 2 分别识别
findingCaveats: PlayedTime is a day-to-minute mapping; TotalPlayTime is derived by summing it.
Full-library JSON export inside ZIP and version-2 per-install metadata backup are distinct inputs.
Daily aggregates cannot create precise native activities.

items.name: calibre
items.baselineAndInput: v9.16.0；一致的 `metadata.db` 与书库目录，或明确范围的 OPF/书目导出
items.migrationValue: 本地书库组织、作者、系列序号、标识、标签、评分，以及数据库中的阅读位置、书签与高亮备注
items.boundaries: 完整书库与单纯书目导出的能力不同；标注按书籍、格式、用户划分。自定义列、书目 comments、作者资料笔记和用户高亮分别解释
findingCaveats: metadata.db includes annotations and last_read_positions, in addition to bibliographic metadata.
Annotation scope includes book, format and user; deleted annotations need explicit handling.
Bibliographic exports, author/tag notes and reader highlights have different scopes.

items.name: Mihon / Tachiyomi Backup
items.baselineAndInput: Mihon v0.21.2；按 gzip 标记识别后解析 protobuf Backup，保留明确验证的 Tachiyomi 备份系列
items.migrationValue: 书库、分类、章节已读与书签、漫画笔记、来源链接和阅读历史；在线漫画使用习惯直接相关
items.boundaries: 备份不含下载章节与自定义封面；`favorite` 不能未经语义核对就当本体特别喜爱。历史的最近阅读时间与累计阅读时长不是逐次区间；分支字段分别识别
findingCaveats: Backup fields include manga notes and chapter read/bookmark/progress data.
The backup omits chapter files and custom covers.
v0.21.0 release notes announce the last major series compatible with Tachiyomi backups.
A lastRead timestamp plus accumulated readDuration does not establish a per-session interval.

items.name: NFO
items.baselineAndInput: Kodi 的 movie、tvshow、episodedetails；ComicInfo 1.0/2.0，2.1 草案单独判断
items.migrationValue: 动画与漫画用户随文件保存的资料、外部身份、署名和适用个人记录；跨软件输入，职责较窄
items.boundaries: 两种格式不是同一个 schema；ComicInfo `Volume` 不是日漫单行本卷号。Kodi 片长、播放计数和续播位置有不同含义；输入根元素本身不证明内容是动画
findingCaveats: ComicInfo 2.1 is a draft; stable 2.0 and draft-specific fields must remain distinguishable.
ComicInfo Volume describes US-comics publication volume, not automatically a manga collected-volume number.
Kodi runtime, playcount and resume position have different semantics.
The input format does not establish that a film or series is animated.

items.name: LunaBox
items.baselineAndInput: v1.13.3；数据库备份 ZIP 内 `database/` 为 DuckDB 导出，另含封面；全量包还带其他目录和配置
items.migrationValue: 起止时间及秒级时长、个人评价、路线与章节进度文字、分类、图片和本地配置，都有真实迁移价值
items.boundaries: 需独立解释 DuckDB 导出 CSV 与 schema，不能把它当 SQLite 或执行包内 SQL；区分资料评分与个人评价；全量备份与存档 ZIP 不是同一种输入
findingCaveats: DuckDB EXPORT DATABASE creates schema/load SQL plus table CSV; these are not SQLite files.
Game-review rating is separate from source metadata rating.
Full-data backups, database backups and save-game archives are distinct.
Removal is a scope recommendation, not a claim of inactivity or technical infeasibility.

items.name: ReinaManager
items.baselineAndInput: v0.32.0；`VACUUM INTO` 产生 `reina_manager_*.db`；自定义封面另有备份
items.migrationValue: 来源资料与用户覆盖、个人评分和评价、合集、真实会话、汇总统计及本地配置
items.boundaries: 当前会话 `duration` 存储四舍五入的分钟，起止时间另存；不能当秒读，也不能把超过区间长度的取整时长强塞进活动。数据库与封面备份需明确配套
findingCaveats: The database backup uses SQLite VACUUM INTO; custom covers have a separate backup path.
Session endpoints are stored separately from duration in rounded minutes.
Rounded duration can exceed elapsed interval length and cannot be silently forced into a precise native activity.
Removal is a scope recommendation, not a claim that the software is unreliable.

items.name: LaunchBox
items.baselineAndInput: 公开插件文档标注 13.5；官方备份说明与公开平台 XML 实例，未验证当前所有版本
items.migrationValue: 平台库、游戏整理、列表、个人星级、完成标记、累计时长和可转换的启动配置；保留主机与模拟器游戏库的迁出入口
items.boundaries: Data 备份不含 ROM、模拟器或图片。公开 API 字段不等于完整 XML schema；不能把所有 `Notes` 当私人笔记，不能恢复或执行脚本
findingCaveats: Public API documentation identifies assembly version 13.5; it is not evidence for every current XML dialect.
The publicly posted XML is a user specimen, not a vendor schema.
The data backup excludes ROMs, emulator programs and media.
Notes may contain scraped descriptions and cannot be assumed to be a private review.

items.name: Koodo Reader
items.baselineAndInput: v2.4.6；ZIP 内 `config/*.db`、配置 JSON、书籍与封面；另有笔记 JSON 导出
items.migrationValue: 书架、收藏、书签、笔记、高亮和阅读位置；笔记导出带书名、作者、文件 MD5 与原笔记字段
items.boundaries: 当前备份数据库为 SQLite；不能沿用“全是 JSON”的假设。CFI、range、page、percentage 语义不同；纯笔记导出不代表全书库迁移
findingCaveats: The inspected backup uses SQLite databases under config with separate JSON settings and optional book/cover directories.
The inspected note JSON preserves original note fields and adds bookName, bookAuthor and bookMd5.
CFI, range, page and percentage require actual-file and coordinate checks.

items.name: Anx Reader
items.baselineAndInput: v1.14.0；`app_database.db`，当前 schema 版本 7；明确的书库文件与 MD/TXT/CSV 笔记导出
items.migrationValue: 书库分组、个人评分、摘录、用户批注、书签和 CFI 阅读位置；用户文字无法由 EPUB 扫描恢复
items.boundaries: 笔记 CSV 不带 CFI，数据库才有；阅读时长在写入时按书和日期合并，不能因模型存在 `startedAt` 就当逐次会话
findingCaveats: The inspected app_database.db schema version is 7.
The inspected CSV note export omits CFI while the database note model contains it.
Reading-time DAO aggregates by book and calendar day despite a startedAt parameter.

items.name: KOReader
items.baselineAndInput: v2026.07.1；exporter 的 JSON 与 `.sdr/metadata.*.lua` 数据；另核对统计库实现
items.migrationValue: 电子墨水设备等场景中的高亮、笔记、书签与阅读状态；官方 JSON 可直接导出文字
items.boundaries: JSON 与 sidecar 保存范围不同；sidecar 只解析数据，不执行 Lua。XPointer、重排页码与本体位置不能直接等同；统计库是另一输入范围
findingCaveats: The JSON exporter and Lua sidecars have different information scopes.
Lua sidecars must be parsed as data, not executed.
Statistics are held in a separate SQLite input; raw page rows and rescaled views must not be conflated.

items.name: Kotatsu
items.baselineAndInput: 已归档仓库提交 `34f6e523`；ZIP 内 index、history、categories、favourites、bookmarks、statistics 等 JSON 数组
items.migrationValue: 旧漫画书库、分类、来源链接、阅读进度与书签；软件停止维护后仍需要迁出这些积累
items.boundaries: 归档状态不等于备份不可读。当前核验不是发行版兼容测试；在线源标识、章节 ID 和远端页位不能冒充本体身份或本地位置
findingCaveats: The source snapshot is an archived development commit, not a verified release format.
ZIP members are JSON arrays named index/history/categories/favourites/bookmarks/statistics, without mandatory .json suffixes.
Remote chapter/page identifiers do not establish local-file identity or native activity intervals.

items.name: YACReader
items.baselineAndInput: 10.4.0；`.yacreaderlibrary/library.ydb` 或正式库备份，SQLite；另有部分资料 `.ydb` 导出
items.migrationValue: 本地漫画文件对应、用户修改资料、评分、已读、当前页、书签、标签与阅读列表；与在线漫画备份不同
items.boundaries: “Export comics info” 只选出部分 comic_info 行，且不包含完整库关系；不能拿它替代全库备份。文件页序、多个库内部 ID 与缺失图片分别核对
findingCaveats: Full-library SQLite backups differ from the partial comics-info export.
exportComicsInfo selects edited records or records carrying ComicVine IDs and omits the whole library relationship graph.
Native page positions require matching the actual comic file and page order.
